description: This Java class defines an abstract superclass for managing event strategies, including registration and handling of events based on their class type within a persistent actor system.

classes.name: AbstractEventStrategies
classes.description: An immutable abstract class providing a framework for registering and handling event strategies based on event class types.

methods.name: addStrategy
methods.description: Registers a new event handling strategy for a specific event class type. Intended to be called in constructor of subclasses.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Executes the appropriate event strategy based on the runtime class of the event, or logs an error if none is found.
